fi-mikrogeophagus-ramirezi.title: German Blue Ram (incl. Electric Blue, Gold and Balloon strains)
fi-mikrogeophagus-ramirezi.summary: A small, jewel-colored dwarf cichlid that needs warm, soft, very clean water.
rows: About 1.6 in (4 cm) body length. Males are larger
24 × 12 in footprint (about 15 gal) or larger for one pair
Peaceful, but pairs defend a territory about 2 ft across when breeding
Keep singly or as a pair. Calm schooling fish nearby make it less shy
Sifts the substrate for food. Live or frozen bloodworm, brine shrimp and daphnia plus small sinking pellets
Moderate. Needs stable, clean water and isn't a good fit for a general community tank
notes: Never add to a new tank. Use gentle flow and small regular water changes (10–15%).
Good tankmates are peaceful fish that also like the heat, such as cardinal tetras. Avoid other cichlids and boisterous fish.
Fancy strains like gold, long-fin and balloon tend to be weaker and shorter-lived than wild-type fish.
warn: Needs warmer water (81–86°F) than most community fish.
